title: beta-stellar-raw-capture-v619
implementation: Added V619 raw capture plans for Acrux, Spica, Regulus and Polaris with explicit transport choices, timeout, retry backoff, request URL, endpoint and immutable V616 digests.
Added a sealed raw-response envelope validator requiring SIMBAD HTTPS identity, exact request URL, HTTP 200, allowlisted content type, non-empty body, byte count and recomputable SHA-256.
Added fixture-replay and raw-only boundaries; fixture HTML cannot be promoted to structured scientific evidence and no response is counted until an envelope is verified.
Added TypeScript status, transport, retry, integrity, digest and admission utilities and connected V619 pending rows/details to the Beta hero review panel.
Recorded a real external probe attempt separately: SIMBAD HTTPS page timed out after 10 seconds with TaskCanceledException; no synthetic response was created.

combinedRegressionNode.note: V615 through V619 regression; stale and forged inputs are negative cases.

eslint.scope: V619 generator, utility, tests and Beta hero review panel

mobile.reason: In-app viewport override remains unavailable in this run; no mobile pass is claimed

browser.scope: HTTP, browser and visual interaction evidence only; not physical-device performance, public deployment, legal clearance, real-user validation or scientific validation
